versions.changelog:
- Overhauled and greatly simplified instructions for clarity and direct user action, now focused on step-by-step Mandarin guidance.
- All CLI command references updated to explicitly use version exportdou@1.0.3.
- Integrated key workflow and troubleshooting content directly; deprecated separate references/commands.md, references/errors.md, and skill-card.md.
- Added clearer rules and explanations for dealing with login, quota, file formats, replies, and error codes.
- Streamlined use cases and emphasized safe export practices, account requirements, and user privacy.

- Added new guidance for handling partial export results, including using the resume command to continue incomplete tasks.
- Clarified that --all must not be combined with --replies; use an explicit --limit for exports including replies.
- Updated export size instructions to refer specifically to root comments for --all mode.
- Removed the legacy skill-card.md file.
- Documentation improvements in commands and error handling references.

- skill-card.md removed from the repository.
- SKILL.md updated with a fixed link for the CLI guide (now points to https://exportdou.cn/developers#agent).
- No changes to functionality or workflow.
首次发布：支持公开抖音视频评论与回复导出、预览、任务状态和下载。
